messages:
rachel_cs: Quick flag  running a small audit and noticed the 'welcome-path' playbook fired twice for ~52 accounts overnight. likely caused some CRM webhook retries.

omar_ops: can you share an example account and the note body?

rachel_cs: example ACCT-3021 - two notes 9s apart, body = 'Welcome to Redwood! Here's your onboarding checklist.'

playbook-bot: autopilot: rule welcome-path fired 52 times between 2025-11-04T23:12:01Z and 2025-11-04T23:12:15Z; dedupe_policy=off in prod.

jules_eng: probable cause: crm-webhook client retried identical payload after transient timeout; runner treated each delivery as unique. i'll add event_id dedupe keyed for 2m window. quick patch planned.

omar_ops: short-term mitigation: suppress welcome-path for segments ["trial","small-business"] for 90m via ops endpoint. curl: `POST /ops/playbook/suppress` body `{ "rule": "welcome-path", "segments": ["trial","small-business"], "ttl": "90m" }`

leah_enable: of the 52, which are within 120/60/30 days of renewal? want to prioritize outreach.

rachel_cs: counts: 9 <120d, 2 <60d, 0 <30d. exporting CSV to s3://cs-exports/welcome_dupes_3123456789.csv and tagging high-touch.

jules_eng: PR opened to add idempotency: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8780. will add integration test for webhook replay and monitor logs after deploy.

omar_ops: suppression applied, response=202. running a cleanup job to collapse duplicate notes matching exact body within 20s window and tagging deletions with audit='dedupe-3123456789'.

rachel_cs: thanks — assigning the 11 high-touch accounts to enablement and adding to tomorrow's ops sync agenda.
